title: 二楼四号房  (Room Four on the Second Floor)

segments.t: At the front desk, retired piano teacher Song steps inside from her taxi pulling a heavy dark-blue suitcase. Qing greets her first guest while Chen waits nearby to carry the luggage. Let's hear how it goes.
欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
太谢谢你们两位了。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
'Welcome! Good morning, hello!'
早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
'Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.'
是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
'Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?'
很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
'Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.'
我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
'Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?'
只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
'Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!'
给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
'Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.'
太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
'Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?'
朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
'Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.'
正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
'Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?'
从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
'Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.'
太谢谢你们两位了。
'Thank you both so very much.'

Qing handled her first check-in smoothly, though Chen noticed that dark-blue suitcase felt unusually heavy. See you next time to find out why.
回头见！
